status: LOCKED from approved sample family unless teacher explicitly requests redesign
student_structure: figures/tables only when they serve the task
teacher_structure: Page-for-page student replica. Add red teacher-answer/sample-answer/evaluation text inside the existing student workspaces; preserve the student wording, order, representations, and page identity.
caption_rule: No descriptive student-facing captions under graphs/tables/figures. Keep only mathematically necessary labels inside representations.
format_not_action: Within Algebra, the CSS/visual shell is stable and does not prescribe the performance action; collect/model, movement, build/generalize, audit/repair, create/trade, decision/optimization, and other valid actions may use the same CSS. Other course Frameworks may define different action/material structures and may explicitly adapt their presentation layer.
packaging_rule: Shared course-root CSS dependency; do not copy this stylesheet into the Performance Task/Quick Check resource root.
render_fidelity: Same CSS does not mean same page/card choreography. Renderer follows mapped action; universal 2-page/5-card output across unrelated tasks is a failure signal.
mathjax: Use the established course-wide dollar-delimiter contract: inlineMath = $ / $, displayMath = $$ / $$, processEscapes true, async tex-mml-chtml.js. This must match the Framework finalizer and MathJax repair tool.
